HOST = "crypto.chal.csaw.io"
PORT = 8000

responses = []

    io = remote(HOST, PORT)

    # Receive the first welcome line + the challenge
    line = io.recvline()
    responses.append(("recv", line.decode(errors="replace")))
    
    # Look for the 128-char hex string (challenge)

        return
    challenge = match.group(1)
    responses.append(("challenge", challenge))

    # Send the challenge back
    io.sendline(challenge.encode())
    first_response = io.recvline(timeout=2)
    responses.append(("first_response", first_response.rstrip().decode(errors="replace")))

    if first_response.strip().decode() != challenge:
        # If output is different from input, echo result back
        io.sendline(first_response.rstrip())
        second_response = io.recvline(timeout=2)
        responses.append(("second_response", second_response.rstrip().decode(errors="replace")))

    # Output the response chain
